name: Should I replace galvanized pipes during a remodel in an older home?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace galvanized pipes during a remodel in an older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your older home has galvanized pipes, especially common in areas like San Francisco and Oakland, replacing them during a remodel is often a wise investment. Galvanized pipes are prone to corrosion, leading to reduced water pressure, discolored water, and potential leaks over time. While replacement adds to the initial project cost, it significantly improves water quality, pressure, and the overall longevity of your plumbing system, preventing more extensive and costly repairs down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing galvanized pipes during a remodel is often recommended for older homes to prevent corrosion, improve water quality, and avoid future leaks.
